faq.title: Your questions, answered
faq.description: Everything you need to know about your daily patch routine.

what.question: What are Luvlae Berberine Patches?
what.answer: They are topical adhesive patches containing berberine and other listed ingredients, in a discreet, pill-free format.

count.question: How many patches come in a box?
count.answer: Each box contains 60 patches — a 60-day supply when used once daily.

apply.question: How do I apply a patch?
apply.answer: Peel off the protective backing, apply to clean, dry, intact skin in an area recommended on the package, and gently press down the edges.

wear.question: How long should I wear each patch?
wear.answer: Follow the wear time printed on your package. Remove the patch earlier if you experience irritation or discomfort.

clothing.question: Can I wear a patch under clothing?
clothing.answer: Yes. Choose an application area recommended on the package where clothing will not rub against or loosen the patch.

water.question: Can I shower, swim, or exercise while wearing it?
water.answer: Check the package instructions for guidance on water exposure and exercise. Do not assume the patch is waterproof.

skin.question: What if I have sensitive skin?
skin.answer: Review the ingredients before use. Do not use if you have a known allergy to any ingredient or the adhesive. Stop use if redness, itching, or discomfort occurs.

oral.question: Are patches the same as oral berberine supplements?
oral.answer: No. The formats differ, and studies of oral berberine do not establish absorption or benefits from Luvlae patches.

medication.question: Can I use the patches while taking medication?
medication.answer: Consult a healthcare professional before use and show them the full ingredient list, especially if you take medication or have a medical condition.

pregnancy.question: Can I use them during pregnancy or breastfeeding?
pregnancy.answer: As a precaution, do not use during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.

storage.question: How should I store the patches?
storage.answer: Follow the storage instructions on the package. Keep them out of reach of children and pets.

buy.question: Where can I buy Luvlae Berberine Patches?
buy.answer: See the product purchase section for current pricing and availability.

berberine.name: Berberine
berberine.description: A naturally occurring plant compound studied for its potential role in glucose and lipid metabolism, primarily in oral formulations.

fenugreek.name: Fenugreek seed extract
fenugreek.description: A botanical with a long history of use in food and traditional practices, including digestive wellness.

chromium.name: Chromium
chromium.description: A trace mineral studied for its involvement in insulin action and the metabolism of carbohydrates, fats, and proteins.

ginseng.name: Panax ginseng extract
ginseng.description: A traditional botanical studied for fatigue and aspects of cognitive function.

greenTea.name: Green tea extract
greenTea.description: An extract known for its naturally occurring polyphenols, including catechins, which have antioxidant properties.

cinnamon.name: Cinnamon bark extract
cinnamon.description: A familiar botanical studied for its plant compounds and potential effects on glucose metabolism.

ginger.name: Ginger root extract
ginger.description: A traditional botanical best known for its use in digestive wellness and research on nausea when taken orally.

carnitine.name: L-carnitine
carnitine.description: A compound naturally present in the body that helps transport fatty acids into cells’ mitochondria for energy production.

b12.name: Vitamin B12
b12.description: A vitamin involved in normal nerve function, red blood cell formation, and DNA synthesis.

magnesium.name: Magnesium
magnesium.description: A mineral involved in energy production and normal muscle and nerve function.

vitaminC.name: Vitamin C (as ascorbic acid)
vitaminC.description: A vitamin involved in collagen formation, normal immune function, and antioxidant protection.

reviews.title: Let’s talk about the little things
reviews.description: From the first application to packing for a weekend away — read the full stories.
reviews.label: Review
reviews.disclosure: Reviewer names and star ratings are illustrative; they were not supplied with these review texts.
reviews.note: Reviews describe individual experiences with the format, not evidence of health effects.

one.title: A simple start to the morning
one.body: I’m always looking for ways to keep my morning routine simple, so the patch format caught my attention. These are easy to apply, and I like that I don’t have to prepare a drink or swallow another capsule. I usually put one on while getting dressed. It’s a straightforward little step that fits into my day.

two.title: A discreet little step
two.body: What I appreciate most is how discreet the patches are. I wear mine under clothing, so it doesn’t become something I have to explain or draw attention to. The application is simple, too. For someone who prefers a low-fuss routine, the format is really appealing.

three.title: Thoughtfully part of my routine
three.body: I’m in my 40s, and I’ve become much more selective about what I add to my daily routine. I wanted something easy to use, with ingredient information I could read before trying it. The box contains 60 patches, which is convenient, and the directions make application straightforward. I also like the compact packaging.

four.title: My first time trying patches
four.body: I hadn’t used this kind of patch before, so I took a little time to read the directions and get familiar with it. Applying one turned out to be simple — peel off the backing, place it on clean, dry skin, and press down the edges. I like having a pill-free option, and the subtle pearly design is a nice touch.

five.title: Fits around a changing schedule
five.body: My schedule changes a lot between working from home and going into the office, so I appreciate a product that doesn’t require much preparation. The box is compact enough to tuck into a bag, and the patches are easy to apply. Having 60 in one pack is practical. The convenience of the format is what stands out to me.

six.title: Ready and on with my morning
six.body: OMG, these are so easy to use! I put one on while I’m getting ready and get on with my morning. I already have enough stuff on my bathroom counter, so I appreciate something this simple.

seven.title: A format that makes sense for me
seven.body: Honestly, the no-pill thing is what sold me on trying them. I’m terrible at swallowing capsules, lol. The patch format just makes more sense for my routine.

eight.title: Here for the pearly design
eight.body: 😍 Okay, the little pearly patches are actually really cute. 😂 I know that’s a small detail, but I like the design. Application was easy once I read the instructions.

nine.title: Easy to figure out
nine.body: I wasn’t sure what to expect because I’d never tried patches like these before. Turns out the application is pretty straightforward. No complicated setup, which is a win for me.

ten.title: A little box with plenty inside
ten.body: Love that there are 60 in the box! I don’t want to be reordering something every couple of weeks. The packaging is small too, so it doesn’t take over my drawer.

eleven.title: Made for busy mornings
eleven.body: My mornings are usually coffee, getting dressed, and rushing out the door. These fit into that pretty easily. I’m all for anything that doesn’t add another ten minutes to getting ready.

twelve.title: Keeping my routine to myself
twelve.body: The discreet design is probably my favorite part. I prefer wearing mine somewhere covered by my clothes. Just a personal preference, but I like keeping my routine to myself.

thirteen.title: Ingredients first
thirteen.body: Not gonna lie, I checked out the ingredients before anything else. I like knowing what’s in a product before I try it. Having that information easy to find was a big plus.

fourteen.title: Packed for the weekend
fourteen.body: Packed these for a weekend away and barely noticed the box in my bag. Nice to have something that doesn’t involve bottles, scoops, or mixing anything. Pretty convenient.

fifteen.title: A few steps I can get behind
fifteen.body: I’m usually the person who buys something and then gets annoyed by all the steps involved, haha. This was easy to figure out. Read the directions, peel, apply — that part I can manage!

privacyPage.introduction: This Privacy Policy explains how EverMotion Parts LLC, the company operating Luvlae (“Luvlae,” “we,” “us,” or “our”), collects, uses, and shares personal information when you visit www.luvlae.com, make a purchase, or contact us.

before.item1: Depending on how you interact with us, we may collect:

items.item1: Contact information: Your name, email address, telephone number, and billing and shipping addresses.
items.item2: Order information: Products purchased, order history, payment status, and delivery details.
items.item3: Payment-related information: Transaction identifiers and limited payment details provided by our payment processors, such as card type and the last four digits of a card.
items.item4: Communications: Information you provide when contacting customer support or submitting feedback.
items.item5: Device and usage information: Your IP address, browser type, device information, pages viewed, and interactions with our website, collected through cookies or similar technologies where enabled.
items.item6: Marketing preferences: Your subscription status and communication preferences.

after.item1: Please do not send full payment card details or sensitive medical information by email.

items.item2: Send order confirmations, shipping updates, and other service communications.
items.item3: Provide customer support and handle cancellations, replacements, and refunds.
items.item4: Maintain, secure, and improve our website.
items.item5: Detect and prevent fraud or unauthorized activity.
items.item6: Send marketing communications where permitted and in accordance with your preferences.
items.item7: Meet legal, tax, accounting, and recordkeeping obligations.

before.item1: We share relevant personal information with service providers as necessary to operate our business, including:

items.item1: Website hosting and e-commerce service providers.
items.item2: Payment processors, including Stripe when you pay through Stripe.
items.item4: Customer support and email service providers.
items.item5: Analytics and advertising providers, where those tools are enabled and subject to applicable consent requirements.

after.item1: For example, we may provide your name, shipping address, and necessary order details to a fulfillment provider so it can deliver your purchase.
after.item2: We may also disclose information when required by law, to protect rights and prevent fraud, or in connection with a merger, acquisition, or transfer of our business.

before.item1: Payments are processed by third-party payment providers. When you pay through Stripe, your payment information is handled according to Stripe’s privacy policy, available at https://stripe.com/privacy.
before.item2: We do not receive or store your full payment card number or security code when payment is processed through our hosted payment provider.

before.item1: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to support essential functions, remember preferences, understand website activity, and support marketing where enabled.
before.item2: Where required by applicable law, we request consent before using non-essential cookies or similar technologies. You can manage cookies through your browser settings and, where available, our website’s cookie preference controls.
before.item3: Disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality.

before.item1: If you subscribe to marketing emails, you can unsubscribe at any time using the link in an email or by contacting us at luvlae.care@gmail.com.
before.item2: Opting out of marketing does not prevent us from sending necessary communications about your orders, payments, or customer support requests.

before.item1: We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, including processing orders, providing support, resolving disputes, and meeting legal, tax, and accounting obligations.
before.item2: Retention periods depend on the type of information and the reason it was collected.

before.item1: We use reasonable technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal information. Our website uses HTTPS to help protect information transmitted through the site.
before.item2: No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

before.item1: Depending on where you live and which laws apply, you may have rights to:

items.item1: Request access to personal information we hold about you.
items.item2: Request correction or deletion of personal information.
items.item3: Obtain a copy of your information.
items.item4: Object to or restrict certain uses of your information.
items.item5: Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
items.item6: Opt out of certain advertising-related uses or disclosures.

after.item1: To submit a request, email luvlae.care@gmail.com. We may need to verify your identity before completing your request. Some information may be retained where required or permitted by law.

before.item1: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies, which we encourage you to review.

We may update this Privacy Policy as our business or practices change. Updates will be published on this page with a revised “Last updated” date. Where required by law, we will provide additional notice.
